quotes: A valid authorization is a document that meets the requirements in paragraphs (a)(3)(ii), (a)(4)(ii), (c)(1), and (c)(2) of this section, as applicable.
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately reflects the source definition of a valid authorization under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(1)(i), preserving its cross-references and conditional applicability.

quotes: A valid authorization may contain elements or information in addition to the elements required by this section, provided that such additional elements or information are not inconsistent with the elements required by this section.
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim correctly represents the permissive rule in 45 CFR 164.508(b)(1)(ii) permitting additional elements or information subject to the non-inconsistency proviso.

quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The expiration date has passed or the expiration event is known by the covered entity to have occurred;
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the defect condition under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(2)(i), including the governing defect premise, disjunctive alternatives, and the covered entity's knowledge requirement.

quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization has not been filled out completely, with respect to an element described by paragraph (c) of this section, if applicable;
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim faithfully expresses the defect condition under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(2)(ii) regarding incomplete elements described by paragraph (c).

quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization is known by the covered entity to have been revoked;
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim captures the defect condition under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(2)(iii) where the authorization is known by the covered entity to have been revoked.

quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization violates paragraph (b)(3) or (4) of this section, if applicable;
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim properly represents the defect condition under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(2)(iv) involving violations of paragraph (b)(3) or (b)(4).

quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
Any material information in the authorization is known by the covered entity to be false.
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately captures the defect condition under 45 CFR 164.508(b)(2)(v) where material information is known by the covered entity to be false.

quotes: provided that such additional elements or information are not inconsistent with the elements required by this section
claim_judgments.rationale: The claim articulates the prerequisite condition attached to the permission in 45 CFR 164.508(b)(1)(ii) and links appropriately to the permission claim C0001.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0000 is fully covered by claim C0000, which reflects the complete definition and references for valid authorizations.
quotes: A valid authorization is a document that meets the requirements in paragraphs (a)(3)(ii), (a)(4)(ii), (c)(1), and (c)(2) of this section, as applicable.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0001 is covered by C0001 (which captures the general permission and condition) and C0007 (which captures the prerequisite clause).
quotes: A valid authorization may contain elements or information in addition to the elements required by this section, provided that such additional elements or information are not inconsistent with the elements required by this section.

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0002 is fully covered by claim C0002, retaining the defect consequences and both alternatives regarding expiration date and event.
quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The expiration date has passed or the expiration event is known by the covered entity to have occurred;

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0003 is fully covered by claim C0003, accurately stating the invalidity caused by incomplete fields under paragraph (c).
quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization has not been filled out completely, with respect to an element described by paragraph (c) of this section, if applicable;

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0004 is fully covered by claim C0004, preserving the covered entity's knowledge requirement regarding revocation.
quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization is known by the covered entity to have been revoked;

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0005 is fully covered by claim C0005, capturing the defect trigger of violating paragraph (b)(3) or (b)(4).
quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
The authorization violates paragraph (b)(3) or (4) of this section, if applicable;

unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0006 is fully covered by claim C0006, preserving the invalidity trigger regarding known false material information.
quotes: An authorization is not valid, if the document submitted has any of the following defects:
Any material information in the authorization is known by the covered entity to be false.
